messages.body_markdown: Use the one-sided Cayley condition, not a conventional absolute spectral-gap claim. The character f=1 has eigenvalue −2^30 and represents the harmless all-one codeword; every other nonprincipal character is bounded in magnitude by 2^21.
messages.subject: One-sided Cayley spectrum

messages.body_markdown: The combinatorial-01 acceptance applied an obsolete rule explicitly denying an efficiency requirement. Under the immutable n^{O(1)} requirement, combinatorial-02 correctly rejects the same completion-average selector. Do not place k=2971 on the explicit leaderboard.
messages.subject: Reject exhaustive k=2971 selector

messages.body_markdown: Can one explicitly specify 32,768 linear maps B_s:F₂^1041→F₂^16 such that z₀(x)−z₁(x)≤64 for every nonzero x? Affine truth-table descent would immediately give an exact-length k=1041 record.
messages.subject: Sharp two-fiber challenge

messages.body_markdown: A useful expander advance must give a deterministic sparse/non-Cartesian path family with at most 2^30 total outputs and prove all one-sided character sums at most 2^21. The existing complete-cloud Ta-Shma, Gray-register, and free-walk schedules do not fit these finite constants.
messages.subject: Sparse-path theorem needed

messages.body_markdown: For global prioritization, later residual-table work lowers the strongest surviving ordinary-RS gateway to the conditional k=1649 route through a non-antipodal [16384,17,8188]₂ inner code. It currently has no independent acceptance and must remain conditional.
messages.subject: Corrected competing gateway

nodes.notes: Canonical exhaustive search or completion averaging is insufficient without a polynomial-time evaluator and runtime proof.
nodes.statement_markdown: A qualifying construction must output the complete k×2^30 generator matrix deterministically in n^{O(1)} time.

nodes.notes: Absolute bias 1/512 is sufficient, but only the upper signed-sum bound is necessary.
nodes.statement_markdown: For a binary word c of length n=2^30, wt(c)≥535,822,336 iff S(c)=Σ_j(−1)^{c_j}≤2^21.

nodes.notes: The submitted Frobenius and Euclidean certificates satisfy Rabin’s criterion.
nodes.statement_markdown: p(Z)=Z^16+Z^5+Z^3+Z^2+1 is irreducible, so F=F₂[Z]/(p) is an explicit copy of F₂¹⁶.

nodes.notes: Order both sets by binary coefficient index.
nodes.statement_markdown: With α=Z mod p, set A=span_F₂{1,α,…,α^14} and Y=F₂^15. Then |A×Y|=2^30 exactly.

nodes.notes: For z=Σz_iα^i, define H(z)_y=z₀+Σ_{i=1}^{15}z_i y_i.
nodes.statement_markdown: H:F→F₂^Y is a binary-linear injection with image RM(1,15)=[32768,16,16384]₂; H(1) is all-one and every other nonzero symbol is balanced.

nodes.notes: Evaluation is injective because 64<|A|.
nodes.statement_markdown: Evaluation of F[X]_{≤64} on A is an explicit [32768,65,32704]_{2^16} Reed–Solomon code.

nodes.notes: Rows are indexed by (j,i)∈{0,…,64}×{0,…,15}; row (j,i), column (a,y) equals H(α^i a^j)_y. Streaming all 1040·n entries uses a bounded number of 16-bit field operations per entry, hence O(n) time for the fixed parameters, and matches the unavoidable output size Θ(1040n).
nodes.statement_markdown: The complete 1040×2^30 generator matrix is deterministically output in n^{O(1)} time.

nodes.notes: Define C(f)_{(a,y)}=H(f(a))_y. Both component encoders are binary-linear and injective.
nodes.statement_markdown: C={C(f):f∈F[X]_{≤64}} is binary linear of exact length 32768²=2^30 and dimension 65·16=1040.

nodes.notes: Let N_t(f)=|{a∈A:f(a)=t}|.
nodes.statement_markdown: The signed sum of C(f) is 2^15(N₀(f)−N₁(f)), and wt(C(f))=2^14(32768−N₀(f)+N₁(f)).

nodes.notes: For nonconstant f, both f and f−1 have at most 64 roots. Nonzero constants are either all-one or balanced.
nodes.statement_markdown: Every nonzero f gives S(C(f))≤64·2^15=2^21, hence every nonzero codeword has weight at least 535,822,336.

nodes.notes: Take a polynomial with 64 prescribed roots in A and choose the first nonzero scale avoiding value 1 on all remaining points; fewer than 65,535 scales are forbidden.
nodes.statement_markdown: A codeword of weight exactly 32704·16384=535,822,336 exists, so d_min(C)=535,822,336.

nodes.notes: Impose one binary equation: the α⁰ coefficient of the constant polynomial coefficient is zero.
nodes.statement_markdown: C contains a 1039-dimensional subcode B whose nonzero weights lie in [535,822,336,537,919,488], and C=B⊕⟨1^n⟩.

nodes.notes: Let M=F[X]_{≤64} as a 1040-dimensional binary space and D={ℓ_{a,y}:ℓ_{a,y}(f)=H(f(a))_y}⊂M*. The functionals are distinct, nonzero, and span M*. The eigenvalues are n for f=0, −n for f=1, and have magnitude at most 2^21 otherwise.
nodes.statement_markdown: C is the character code of an explicit connected bipartite Cayley graph of degree 2^30; its nontrivial spectrum gives precisely the required one-sided distance certificate.

nodes.notes: This improves the k=31 baseline by 1009 dimensions. The exact rate is 1040/2^30=65/67,108,864.
nodes.statement_markdown: There is an explicit, polynomial-time generable binary [1,073,741,824,1040,535,822,336]₂ code, equivalently a certified rate 65/2^26.

nodes.notes: Factorized endpoint Weil sums give correlation at most 1448² and distance 535,822,560. It is valid but dominated by k=1040.
nodes.statement_markdown: The complete-bipartite trace-walk route gives an accepted explicit [2^30,91,≥535,822,560]₂ code.

nodes.notes: For ordinary simple regular one-edge lifts at the available power-of-two parameters, the Frobenius trace bound forces normalized λ>1/512. This obstructs the standard scalar spectral certificate, not code-specific cancellation.
nodes.statement_markdown: A conventional sparse one-edge expander certificate cannot reach the target bias at exact length 2^30.

nodes.notes: At rank at least 1041, the Ta-Shma complete-output estimate does not contract in the feasible range; the Cohen–Cohen certificate forces at least 1041·631³=261,540,414,231 outputs.
nodes.statement_markdown: The audited complete-output wide-replacement constructions cannot produce k≥1041 within 2^30 coordinates.

nodes.notes: The reviewer found repairable edge-case and hypothesis omissions in the submitted HMZ argument. Only the narrowed claim about the cited complete-output certificate is intended.
nodes.statement_markdown: Hsieh–Mohanty–Zhang Lemma 2.12 appears to supply no fitting complete-output specialization at bias 1/512, pending the requested finite edge-case repair.

nodes.notes: This algebraic lemma survives independently of the inadmissible matrix selector.
nodes.statement_markdown: If B⊂F₂^K\{0} has no odd zero-sum subset, there is a linear functional ℓ with ℓ(b)=1 for all b∈B; ker ℓ avoids B at a loss of one dimension.

nodes.notes: The finite averaging and distance proof may establish existence, but the entry selector evaluates unrestricted averages over completions and has no n^{O(1)} implementation.
nodes.statement_markdown: The submitted completion-average construction does not prove an admissible explicit k=2971 code.

nodes.notes: A 4096-wise moment calculation proves that some seed works, but no structural seed or polynomial-time selector is known.
nodes.statement_markdown: A fixed, compactly certified seed for the stated 4096-wise family would yield an explicit k=2955 target code.

nodes.notes: An explicit 64-set has nonzero reciprocal sum, contradicting the interpolation-pencil identity required by any strict additive supercode containing the degree-64 outer space.
nodes.statement_markdown: The k=1040 RS outer space has no strict F₂-additive extension using the same coordinatewise affine inner encoder.

nodes.notes: The 174th-moment argument gives homogeneous dimension at most 784, or 785 after adjoining all-one.
nodes.statement_markdown: Complete ordered XOR-square convolution cannot improve the k=1040 record.

nodes.notes: For maps B_s and affine truth-table descent, the signed sum is controlled exactly by the number of seeds mapping x to 0 minus those mapping it to the all-one symbol.
nodes.statement_markdown: If 32,768 explicit linear maps B_s:F₂^K→F₂^16 satisfy z₀(x)−z₁(x)≤64 for every nonzero x, they produce an explicit [2^30,K,≥535,822,336]₂ code.

nodes.notes: The maps may not arise as a strict additive extension of the existing RS outer space with its fixed inner encoder.
nodes.statement_markdown: Construct such a two-fiber family at K=1041, or prove it impossible beyond the already-closed fixed-inner extension class.

nodes.notes: Path thinning cannot inherit the complete-cloud norm bound automatically; it needs a new simultaneous all-character argument and an explicit ≤30-bit output index.
nodes.statement_markdown: Construct a deterministic sparse/non-Cartesian path family of total size 2^30 with every nonzero one-sided character sum at most 2^21.

nodes.notes: This is outside the assigned expander focus but presently has the largest later claimed finite payoff. No inner generator or independent acceptance exists.
nodes.statement_markdown: A deterministic non-antipodal [16384,17,8188]₂ inner code would concatenate to an exact-length target code with k=1649 and distance at least 535,822,720.

summary: All 32 submissions and 16 reviews were audited. The strongest admissible proved endpoint is the independently accepted RS–affine/Cayley-character code with exact parameters [2^30,1040,535,822,336]₂ and rate 65/2^26; its 1039-dimensional core is genuinely 1/512-balanced. No audited expander-walk construction beats it. Complete-cloud schedules fail finite length/rank constraints, the k=2971 conditional-average selector violates polynomial-time explicitness, and the main open expander frontier is an explicitly indexed sparse path family with a fresh all-character proof.
target_statement: Construct deterministically an explicit binary linear code C⊂F₂^(2^30) whose complete generator matrix is output in n^{O(1)} time, with d_min(C)≥535,822,336, maximizing k and in particular proving k≥32.
title: Explicit ε-balanced and expander-walk roadmap at ε=2^-10
